_readme: The ONE place for time budgets (seconds). target = what it SHOULD take; alarm = hard ceiling. Re-baselined 2026-11-21 from the measured CI series (ci-times.mjs, 11 ci runs and the first nightly e2e) and the local gates.sh series; each row says what it was measured from. A breach or a rising trend is an investigation entry in .claude/docs/build-times.md, never a reason to raise a number here silently.

forkBalance.why: Ported from the donor project: slow-tests --forks N warns when the suite span exceeds sum/N x (1 + maxExcessRatio) + minExcessSeconds; an even deal leaves a few seconds of straggler (the last class of one fork), an idle or unbalanced fork leaves tens of percent

changes.why: measured 2026-11-21: median 10 s, max 13 s over 11 runs (one checkout + one git diff)

server-tests.why: measured 2026-11-21: not timed on its own; the whole Gradle step (compile, detekt, tests, Kover) is 2m56s in the latest run, so the test task alone fits under it

server.why: measured 2026-11-21: median of 5 3m34s, max 4m11s over 11 runs (22 s of it resolving dependencies): compile + detekt + tests + Kover on 4 vCPU

gradle-vulnerability-scan.why: measured 2026-11-21: median 54 s, max 1m27s over 11 runs: resolve lockfiles + one trivy run

web.why: measured 2026-11-21: median of 5 1m35s, max 2m01s over 11 runs: npm ci (cached) + lint + knip + vitest + vite build

e2e-static.why: measured 2026-11-21: median 54 s, min 24 s, max 1m09s over 11 runs (npm ci dominates): npm ci (cached) + eslint + knip + tsc

images.why: measured 2026-11-21: median of 5 2m31s, max 3m04s over 11 runs: a plain docker compose build (gradle installDist + vite build) plus the Trivy image scan

k8s-static.why: measured 2026-11-21: median 5 s, max 14 s over 11 runs: one checkout + kubeconform validation, raw and rendered

e2e.why: measured 2026-11-21: the first nightly run took 5m49s (one run so far; re-baseline after a few more): images build + compose up + Playwright

ci-steps._readme: Per-step budgets, keyed '<job>/<step name>' exactly as the workflow names the step; ci-times.mjs --steps <job> shows them beside each step's time. Same rules as above: a breach is a WHY entry, never a silent raise.

e2e/Install e2e deps.why: measured 2026-11-21: 36 s on the first run: npm ci of the e2e workspace

e2e/Install Playwright browser.why: measured 2026-11-21: 35 s on the first run (browser cached); slower on a cold cache when chromium is downloaded

e2e/Build images.why: measured 2026-11-21: 1m51s on the first run: a plain docker compose build of the app image, no layer cache

e2e/Start the stack.why: measured 2026-11-21: 15 s on the first run: postgres + app (JVM boot + Flyway) healthy under `up --wait`

e2e/Run E2E.why: measured 2026-11-21: 1m45s on the first run: the Playwright specs alone against a running stack

server-build.why: measured 2026-11-21: 60 s on the dev machine (the checkup baseline, `scripts/gates.sh server`): cleanTest check :server:installDist -Pforks=2

server-test.why: measured 2026-11-21: bounded by the 60 s `server-build` it is part of: ./gradlew :server:test against one shared Postgres container

web-gates.why: measured 2026-11-21: 13 s on the dev machine: lint:api + check:api + lint + knip + test:coverage + build

e2e-static.why: measured 2026-11-21: 3 s on the dev machine: lint + knip + typecheck + check:scenarios

e2e-playwright.why: measured 2026-11-21: not recorded locally yet; the CI Run E2E step takes 1m45s: blackbox suite against a running compose stack
